subject: Light restart offer: quick path to unblock CloudSynapse POC
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Johnson <ava.j@cloudsynapse.com>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@cloudsynapse.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + POC kickoff materials (CloudSynapse)

Hi Ava / Eric —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap:
- Goal: Validate latency and cost-economics for inference on your agent scoring pipeline (10–30 req/s average, 2–4k token context).
- Success criteria: avg latency < 150ms p50 for 2k context on a dedicated GPU, and cost < $0.XX per 1k tokens in steady-state.
- Primary blockers you mentioned: network whitelist + infra lead availability for the bootstrap.

Immediate next steps (suggested):
1) I’ll upload the POC checklist + SLA draft (attached). Please review and flag any non-starters.
2) Monica from our CS team can run a 20–30m kickoff to help your infra team with the VPC peering and the sample workload. Monica@redwood will coordinate timing.
3) If you prefer, we can do a low-friction ‘sandbox run’ where we provision a short-lived instance and run a 10-minute synthetic to demonstrate latency numbers — I can run that with your approval so your infra team doesn’t need to do anything initial.

Attachments: CloudSynapse-POC-Checklist.pdf, SLA-Draft-CloudSynapse.docx

Proposed times for the kickoff: Wed 8/12 10:00–10:30 PDT or Thu 8/13 14:00–14:30 PDT. If those don’t work, share 2 slots that do and Monica will take it.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.m@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for low-latency, cost-effective LLM serving
From: Ava Johnson <ava.j@cloudsynapse.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@cloudsynapse.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + POC kickoff materials (CloudSynapse)

Thanks Rishi —

Appreciate the clear recap. I’ll review the checklist and SLA with Eric and our infra lead (Sam) this week. We’re aiming to get the initial kickoff set for the week of Aug 17; Eric will loop Sam and propose a time.

One question: for the sandbox run, what permissions do you need from our side? If it’s low-touch and you can run it without our infra team, that’d be ideal — we can greenlight that while Sam focuses on the whitelisting.

Best,
Ava
Senior Product Manager, CloudSynapse
ava.j@cloudsynapse.com

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@cloudsynapse.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick nudge — sandbox run / 20-min kickoff

Hi Ava / Eric —

Wanted to follow up — we haven’t seen the provisioning request come through and I don’t see any usage in the trial org yet. Totally understand teams get pulled; two low-friction options to get moving depending on how your priorities look: 

Option A — Fast sandbox run (recommended):
- I provision a 2-hour demo instance and run a short synthetic workload using your typical request size. No infra changes required on your side. Results + token breakdown + latency profile delivered in a 1-pager.
- Time cost to you: zero; we just need a greenlight from the product owner.

Option B — 20-min kickoff with Monica to help Sam with whitelisting and config:
- Monica can walk Sam through the VPC steps and validate the sample payloads.

If you’re interested in Option A I can spin it up as soon as you reply “go” in this thread. If priorities have shifted, say the word and we’ll pause the POC and re-evaluate in 6 weeks.

Calendly (my slots): https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/20min — or tell me two times that work.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@cloudsynapse.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + POC kickoff materials (CloudSynapse) — light-touch restart offer

Ava / Eric —

Just checking in one last time this week. We haven’t seen any trial activity and I wanted to offer a couple of pragmatic ways to move forward without blocking your infra team: 

1) I’ll run the sandbox demo for you on our side — I can provide the latency + token-cost breakdown and a short configuration note for Sam to replicate if/when you’re ready. All I need is a one-line greenlight.

2) If this has lost priority, no worries — we can pause and I’ll check back in 6 weeks. If you reopen later we’ll pick up with the checklist intact so you don’t lose progress.

If helpful, I can also block 30 minutes next Tue (8/25) for a walk-through or we can set a soft hold on a small reserved slot so you can demo to stakeholders without further infra work.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume you want to pause and will follow up in early October. Either way, let me know the preference (restart / pause / transfer).

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.m@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: CloudSynapse-POC-Checklist.pdf, SLA-Draft-CloudSynapse.docx
